blocks.text: Before Yuto Onsad became a teacher, he was a child afraid to speak. In a regular school, unfamiliar language, discrimination, and fear of ridicule silenced him. His father transferred him to Pamulaan Elementary School, where learning began to make sense through his Matigsalug identity. Years later, he returned to teach children from his own community. […]...
